question: Which player from Pakistan is credited with 10 British Open titles and six World Championship crowns in professional squash?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Jahangir Khan.__**

 
• **Jahangir Khan **won the World Open six times, and the **British Open ten consecutive times **(1982-1991).

 
 
• Jahangir Khan is widely regarded as the greatest squash player of all time.
